$comment: Source of truth for /podcast/<slug> audio enclosures and AudioObject schema. Populated only by scripts/generate-podcast-audio.py, which atomically writes file + manifest together so a manifest row never references a missing file. See strategy/podcast-audio-playbook.md. Mirrors the glossary-audio-manifest.json contract.

voice.disclosure: Audio is synthesized narration of the show notes, not a hosted recording. Each enclosure is a deterministic TTS render of the text the episode publishes; replace with a real recording at any time by dropping a new MP3 into app/public/audio/podcast/<slug>.mp3 and re-running scripts/generate-podcast-audio.py with --measure-only.

podcast.title: Indie SaaS Teardowns – Dataset Changelog
podcast.description: Audio enclosures for the Indie SaaS Teardowns Dataset Changelog podcast. Synthesized narration of each episode's show notes; subscribe to the RSS at /feed/podcast.rss.
podcast.author: Maryan, Unlock SaaS
